About me

Discover Jamiu

I’m Jamiu Abdulfatai, a product designer based in Brighton, UK. I make complex products clearer and easier to use.

I believe useful design makes complicated things feel simple

My approach

I design fintech, SaaS, marketplace and AI products, from understanding the problem to the screens and components developers build.

I map user journeys, write requirements and create reusable systems with founders, product teams and developers.

I owned mobile and web design at Horal, shaped payment journeys at Radius, grew into design leadership at Bizinc and worked on banking across four markets at Vista.
